activities.title: Build the skeleton of your Lab 4 deck
activities.intro: Open PowerPoint, Google Slides or Impress and follow your paper storyboard. Type only the titles for now. Tick each step as you finish it.

items: Start a new blank presentation and apply one clean theme.
Slide 1 (Title Slide): My Digital Skills Journey + your name.
Add 4 more slides with Ctrl+M. Give each the layout you wrote on your paper.
Type only the titles from your storyboard. Content comes later.
Duplicate one slide, then delete the copy. Drag one slide to a new position and back.
Save as Lab4 - Your Name.pptx (or .odp in Impress).

blocks.prompt: How many slides does your skeleton have now?
Which shortcut adds a new slide?
A screenshot of your skeleton in the thumbnails pane

help: Can't find Layout? It's on the Home tab.
New slide came out as Title Only? Change it with Home › Layout.
Google Slides saves automatically, but rename the file at the top left.

activities.title: Rehearse with the show keys
activities.intro: Use your Lab 4 skeleton and try all six steps. React with 👍 in the chat when you finish.

items: Press F5. Go forward with Space and back with ←.
Type 4 then Enter to jump to slide 4.
Press B. The screen goes black. Press B again.
Press Esc. Click slide 3, then press Shift + F5.
Right-click slide 5 › Hide Slide, run the show and confirm it's skipped.
Unhide it, then open View › Slide Sorter and back to Normal.

blocks.prompt: Which key starts the show from the current slide?
During the show, how do you jump to slide 4?
What happens to a hidden slide when you run the show?
options: It is deleted from the file

help: F5 does nothing? On many laptops F5 controls brightness or volume. Try Fn + F5, or click the Slide Show icon on the status bar.
Google Slides: use Skip slide instead of Hide Slide.
